title: Nutty New-Style Greek Pork Gyro
description: Sweet, pillowy, lazy-sunday Greek dish featuring pineapple chunks and a delicious glaze.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the cinnamon, allspice, and brown sugar.
Rub the spice mixture all over the pork shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the pork in a large baking dish and pour the pineapple juice over it.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 2 hours, or until the pork is tender.
While the pork is cooking, prepare the glaze by mixing the ingredients together in a small saucepan.
Bring the glaze to a boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes, or until thickened.
Once the pork is done, carefully remove it from the oven and brush the glaze all over it.
Let the pork rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for a few minutes.
Assemble the gyro by slicing the pork and placing it in the pita bread, along with some crumbled feta cheese and a sprinkle of chopped parsley.
